caption: The drawing depicts a single rooster facing left, occupying the majority of the central space on a plain, off-white background. The rooster is illustrated in shades of gold and light brown, with subtle gradations providing a sense of volume and texture throughout its body, wings, and tail feathers. The comb, wattle, and beak are clearly delineated, as are the individual feathers on the wing and the elaborate, curving feathers of the tail. The rooster stands on one visible leg with the other leg slightly lifted. There are no other objects or additional colors in the image, and the corners of the paper are visible, with the left and lower edges revealing the black surface beneath the paper.
title: Cock Weather Vane
